header_desc: Injila gnóstico da aka rubuta kusan shekaru dubu biyu da suka wuce, suna ɗauke da maɓalli don ɗaya daga cikin manyan ƙalubale na ilmin lissafi na zamani:  ƙarfin jũjũwa, wanda ke bayyana mana cewa ruhun ɗan adam yana cikin haɗin kai tare da babbar duniya: EGO mai ƙirƙira yana da nauyi yana kuma haifar da ƙarya ta lokaci-da-kayan aiki; don yakar shi, duniya tana ba mu Hangen Nesa na Duniya, wanda ba na lokaci ba ne kuma ba na sarari ba: ƊAYA, wanda jagoransa —da zuciya— ke ba mu damar kunna ƙwayar allah.
left_title: Komawar Sophia: Daga Kurkuku na Yaldabaoth zuwa Masarautar Haske
left_body: A cikin ɗabi'ar juyin juya hali, abu yana nuna wa sararin lokaci yadda zai karyata kuma sararin lokaci yana umartar abu yadda zai motsa. Hakanan, EGO yana da nauyi yana kuma dora nauyinsa: ƙwayar sa tana ɓata tsarin ka na ciki kuma tana dora ƙarya ta lokaci da kayan abu na ruhu 🧠. Don haka, kawai ta hanyar hikimar Sophia za a iya fahimtar cewa umarnin ``Uba da ni ɗaya ne'' kira ne don rushe ``ƙarya ni'' don komawa Masarautar haske mai tsabta inda Uban Mai ɓoyewa yake: gaskiyar ba na lokaci ba ce kuma allahuta ce ta pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Fahimtar cewa mutuwa ba ƙarshe bane, amma canji yana saki mu daga jahilci. A cikin ɓangaren dama, pneuma ɗin mu yana zaune a cikin dandalin ba na lokaci ba ne kuma ba na allahuta ba, dimokiradiyan tsari mai inganci | 999⟩. A nan ne ƙasar haɗin gwiwa da 'yanci take (Ƙasar Uba mai Girma).
center_text: Pistis Sophia da Yaldabaoth: ruhu yana bayyana ta ƙayyadaddun halaye biyu —ruhaniya |ƊAYA⟩ ❤️ da kayan abu |EGO⟩ 🧠—. Wannan yana tabbatar da cewa 'yancin zaɓi yana da halaye na asali na duniya, wanda ba ya shafi ra'ayoyi ko addinai, wanda za a iya tsara shi ta hanyar lissafi azaman samfur mai ciki ⟨ƊAYA|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: Jikin ɗan adam ya ƙunshi carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). A cikin ɓangaren hagu yana zaune a cikin dandalin lokaci da kayan abu, dimokiradiyan tsari mai ƙarancin tsari | 666⟩. Ƙarfin jũjũwa yana ja mu zuwa wuri inda: <q>yaki shine zaman lafiya, 'yancin shine bauta da jahilci shine ƙarfin</q> (1984).
final_quote: Kurkuku ┻ inda kake barci 🧠 yana da ƙofar bude. Kuna buƙatar kawai juya taswirar ✝️ don farka ❤️
p2_sub: Tasun da Gaggawa: Tashar kimiyya da ruhaniya
p2_temario: Tsarin da Jagora na Babban Jigogi (00:00 -- 16:30)
cap1_title: Babi na 1: Annabi na Tasun da Gaggawa footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Tushen da tsarin haɗin gwiwa: sulhu tsakanin basirar jin ƙai na Kudu (zuciya, ilimin kakanni da ruhu) da cigaban fasaha na Arewa (hujja, kimiyya da hankali). Kiran zuwa ga daidaito don farawa da farka na juyin juya hali da wucewa daga matsayin biyu.
cap2_title: Babi na 2: Ƙarfin Jujjawa da Ƙarya ta Lokaci (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: Faskara asali na ilmin lissafi: Ƙa'idodin Juyin Juyawa gaba da Ƙa'idodin Kasuwanci. Me yasa dokokin Newton da Maxwell ba su bambanta tsakanin da ya gabata da gaba ba, karya dakarar lokaci na Einstein da rushewar lokaci mai layi azaman sake gina jiya na tunani.
cap3_title: Babi na 3: Hangen Nesa da Sararin Lokaci (02:47 -- 05:19)
cap3_desc: Kirkirar tsari Faggin--Segarra: jiki azaman hanyar da aka gudanar ta wani filin jujjawa mai hankali a waje na sararin lokaci, inda ake zaune qualia. Hangen nesa ba ya taso daga kwakwalwa amma yana gaba, yana haduwa da Hangen Nesa na Farko da Masanin Kirki wanda ya rage lokaci da sarari.
cap4_title: Babi na 4: Gnosis da Ƙarya ta Kayan Abu (05:27 -- 08:39)
cap4_desc: Samun Nag Hammadi (1945) da takardun copts: samfurin duniya ba a ɗauka a matsayin gida ba, amma a matsayin kurkuku na ruhu. Koyarwar Injila na Thomasi (Logion 3): Yesu ya zo ba don kafa wata addini ba, amma don 'yantar da ƙwayar ƙasa daga kurkuku na Demiurge ta hanyar tunawa (gnosis).
cap5_title: Babi na 5: Masarautar Haske da Kurkukun Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: Demiurge Yaldabaoth —wanda aka sani da babban mai gina kayan abu— shine mai ƙirƙira na duniya mai tsarkaka, allah mai son kai wanda ba ya san amfani na asalin allahuta. A daya hannun, Sophia tana zaune a cikin nauyin kayan abu, tana jiran ƙwayar farkawa.
cap6_title: Babi na 6: Dajjal da Hanyoyin Duniya (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Ilimin ƙarshe da rushewar hangen nesa: siffar Dajjal da karyar gani ta aljanna mai juyawa (kogi da wuta). Tsarin tunani na biyu na orwellian (1984) a matsayin kurkukun tunani na EGO, a kan saƙon juyin juya hali na Yesu wanda ke karya tsarin bauta na masarautar.
cap7_title: Babi na 7: Tunani akan Matsayinmu a Cikin Galaxy (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: Ƙarshe, babban ɓarƙa juyin juya hali yana faɗi haka ne: a cikin faɗin duniya —tare da ƙarin fiye da biliyan guda biyu na taurari— a nan ne furcin Yesu ya fi ƙarfi: “Uba da ni ɗaya ne”. Shin wannan yana da wani saƙo mai ɓoyewa game da dangantaka mai kyau tsakanin ɗan adam da duniya?
sagan_quote: <q>Ra'ayin cewa Allah mutum ne farin fata, mai girma fiye da al'ada, wanda ke zaune a sama yana lissafa faduwar kowanne tsuntsu, yana da ban dariya. Amma idan wani yana nufin Allah a matsayin tarin dokoki na kimiyya wadanda ke jagorantar duniya, to tabbas wannan Allah yana nan. Duk da haka, wannan Allah ba yana ba da jin daɗin zuciya… ba ya da ma'ana sosai don yin addu'a ga dokar jujjawa</q>
